issue.title: Typing a relation in a filter breaks TypeScript
issue.author: marijn
issue.body:
I have this type:

```ts
export type Page = {
  parent?: AcmeResponse<Page>
}
```

When I filter pages without a parent with `{ parent: { slug: { $null: true } } }`, TypeScript says `slug` does not exist in the filter type. Writing `{ parent: { data: { slug: { $null: true } } } }` silences the error but then the filter does not work.

I understand the response shape differs from the filter shape, but how should I write my `Page` type so both work?
